glosses: taki, który charakteryzuje się grzecznością; taki, od którego wymagana jest grzeczność

examples.text: Pewnego dnia, gdy mówiliśmy o zwrotach grzecznościowych, zamiast „na zdrowie” powiedziałem „smacznego” - oczywiście było dużo śmiechu
It's not polite to use a mobile phone in a restaurant.
Try and be polite to Auntie Maria for once.
He marries, bows at court, and grows polite.

I told him about everything I could think of; and what I couldn't think of he did. He asked about six questions during my yarn, but every question had a point to it. At the end he bowed and thanked me once more. As a thanker he was main-truck high; I never see anybody so polite.
rays of light […]falling on […]a polite surface

glosses: To polish; to refine; to render polite.

examples.text: those exercises plied, which polite men's spirits
